capabilities: switch to the last active tab with a hotkey
move the current tab left or right in the tab bar
assign hotkeys directly in the plugin settings
extras: The README notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Includes a vimrc integration snippet for use with Vim-style keymaps.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in Alt-Tab style shortcut to jump back to the tab you were just using.
summary: Tab-switching plugin that toggles between the two most recently active tabs with a hotkey, with commands to move tabs left or right in the tab bar.
